title.fr_fr: Clé USB (données de simulation de vol)

content.en_us:
How to get it :
- [[gv:machine_supercomputer|Supercomputer]] (x2) : [[gv:drive_flash_flightsim|Flash Drive (Flight Simulation Data)]], [[gv:drive_flash_empty|Flash Drive (Empty)]].
- [[gv:machine_supercomputer|Supercomputer]] : [[gv:drive_flash_empty|Flash Drive (Empty)]], 16000 mB helium4.
- [[gv:machine_supercomputer|Supercomputer]] : [[gv:drive_flash_empty|Flash Drive (Empty)]], 16000 mB perfluoromethyl cold.
(1 more recipes: see JEI.)

Used to make :
[[gv:missile_soyuz_lander|Orbital Module]], [[gv:missile_soyuz_0|Soyuz-FG]].
